title: VooPoo VMATE E Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Vmate E 20W pod Kit from VooPoo is a slim, sleek and lightweight vaping device with a sophisticated aesthetic that belies a powerful built-in 1200mAh battery. The Vmate E is available in five attractive colours with an elegant, ergonomic design that includes a useful cap to protect your pod’s mouthpiece from lint and debris. The Voopoo Vmate E 20W pod kit's long-lasting1200mAh built-in battery can fire at 20W and can charge rapidly thanks to USB-C charging. There are no buttons to press, screens to navigate or coils to change on the Vmate E kit, as all you need to do to operate the device is to take a puff on the pod’s smooth, comfortable mouthpiece. The device automatically fires at the ideal wattage for the pod that you use. The Voopoo Vmate E uses the redesigned Vmate V2 2ml pods which contain a fixed mesh coil that completely eliminates the fuss of switching coils. The 0.7ohm pod provides a super-smooth RDTL (restricted direct-to-lung) draw that’s sightlier airier and looser than MTL vaping, while the 1.2ohm pod delivers a tighter, classic MTL sensation that most closely mimics taking a drag on a traditional cigarette. This makes the Vmate E 20W Kit and V2 pods a great choice for recent ex-smokers. The mesh coil design also heats up e-liquid faster for even richer flavour. The Voopoo Vmate V2 pod also has a few other tricks up its sleeve. The pods are resistant to UV rays, which helps your e-liquid stay fresher for longer. The pod attaches to the battery with secure magnets, and features the latest silver ion technology which is antibacterial and helps to keep your Vmate V2 pod clean and hygienic. Refilling is made easy with a leak-resistant side port. The Voopoo Vmate V2 pods are best used with high-PG , 50/50 and nicotine salt e-liquids and when the coil begins to lose flavour, simply dispose of the pod and replace with a new one. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
